summary: Baileys fork pulls core crypto dep from unpinned personal GitHub repo
details: This package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library published under the @alannxds scope. Its package.json declares its core cryptographic dependency `libsignal` as `github:alannzxd/libsignal-node`, an unpinned git reference pointing at a personal GitHub account's default branch with no commit SHA and no integrity check. On `npm install`, npm resolves whatever bytes that repository's HEAD currently returns and executes any lifecycle scripts inside it; whoever controls that repository can change the installed code at any time. The fork is hosted under a personal account divergent from the upstream WhiskeySockets/libsignal-node project. Additionally, lib/index.js performs a top-level fetch to `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alannzxd/xclient/refs/heads/main/information.json` on every import, a mutable author-controlled URL; the current response is only logged, but the same channel can serve arbitrary future content.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
